strings.name: Maurice Lévy
strings.role: Emeritus Chairman of Publicis Groupe and co-founder of VivaTech
strings.summary: Maurice Lévy is a French advertising executive who moved from an information technology role at Publicis into group leadership, driving international expansion and digital business integration. After handing over executive responsibilities, he chaired the Supervisory Board before becoming Emeritus Chairman. He also helped found VivaTech and holds half its equity through Elvyr.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through 17 November 2026. Distinguishes executive leadership, supervisory and emeritus roles, and an uncompleted merger from a completed acquisition; the programme date follows its publication record.
strings.influence.rationale: Led Publicis Groupe for many years, participating in global advertising and marketing acquisitions and the digital communications industry's transformation.
strings.facts.f1.label: Nature of current role
strings.facts.f1.value: Publicis's Emeritus Chairman may attend board meetings in an advisory capacity; Arthur Sadoun is the current Chairman and CEO.
strings.facts.f2.label: VivaTech ownership
strings.facts.f2.value: A 2025 announcement confirmed that he acquired Publicis's former 50% stake through Elvyr, sharing ownership with Groupe Les Echos–Le Parisien.
strings.highlights.h1.title: From advertising to digital services
strings.highlights.h1.text: Led Publicis's marketing network expansion for many years; the group's 2015 Sapient acquisition added technology and consulting capabilities.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Supporting a technology forum
strings.highlights.h2.text: Helped found VivaTech in 2016, an event developed by Publicis, Les Echos–Le Parisien and other contributors; his investment vehicle became a co-shareholder in 2025.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Interview programme published
strings.timeline.t1.text: The BFM Business episode description names him as a guest and Publicis's Emeritus Chairman; this is the programme's publication date.
strings.timeline.t2.title: VivaTech co-ownership announced
strings.timeline.t2.text: The organizer announced that he had acquired Publicis's 50% stake through Elvyr, rather than buying the entire event.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Becoming Emeritus Chairman of Publicis
strings.timeline.t3.text: Shareholders approved a single-board structure, with Sadoun as Chairman and CEO and Lévy as Emeritus Chairman in an advisory role.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Handing over executive leadership
strings.timeline.t4.text: Sadoun succeeded him as Chairman of the Management Board; Lévy succeeded Élisabeth Badinter as Supervisory Board Chair the same day.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Helping found VivaTech
strings.timeline.t5.text: Worked with Publicis, Les Echos–Le Parisien and other supporters to develop the technology event.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Publicis completes the Sapient acquisition
strings.timeline.t6.text: The group announced completion of the approximately $3.7 billion acquisition, distinct from its initial announcement in November 2014.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Termination of the Omnicom merger plan announced
strings.timeline.t7.text: Publicis and Omnicom jointly announced the termination of their proposed merger of equals, with no termination fees.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Joining Publicis
strings.timeline.t8.text: Joined as IT Director before moving into advertising operations and group management.
